# RedNote (Xiaohongshu) MCP Server

> Hosted remote MCP server for RedNote (Xiaohongshu, 小红书, XHS) data: note search by keyword or hashtag, full notes, comments with replies, and creator profiles with their notes. Read-only. No RedNote account; users sign in with a free Apify account (OAuth) and pay per result.

## Install

- Server name: rednote
- Transport: streamable HTTP
- URL: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=fetch-actor-details,get-actor-run,get-dataset-items,zen-studio/rednote-search-scraper,zen-studio/rednote-note-detail-scraper,zen-studio/rednote-comments-scraper,zen-studio/rednote-user-profile-scraper
- Auth: Apify OAuth in the user's browser; alternative header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`
- Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add zen-studio-labs/rednote-xiaohongshu-mcp`, then `claude plugin install rednote@rednote-xiaohongshu-mcp`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/zen-studio-labs/rednote-xiaohongshu-mcp/blob/main/README.md): setup for every client, tools, pricing, FAQ
- [README in Chinese](https://github.com/zen-studio-labs/rednote-xiaohongshu-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Skill](https://github.com/zen-studio-labs/rednote-xiaohongshu-mcp/blob/main/skills/rednote/SKILL.md): run flow, input recipes, tool chaining, field sets

## Tools

- zen-studio/rednote-search-scraper: notes for keywords or hashtags
- zen-studio/rednote-note-detail-scraper: full notes from links or IDs, optional media and subtitle files
- zen-studio/rednote-comments-scraper: comments and replies under notes
- zen-studio/rednote-user-profile-scraper: creator profiles and their notes
